acceptanceCases.case: THE LAYER AT THE CHOOSER: drawRoot(rng, key, pool, layer) returns the layer's value when layerRead is defined AND that value is a member of `pool`, otherwise the drawn value; an override outside `pool` is IGNORED; and in EVERY case the rng is advanced exactly as an unoverridden draw would advance it (asserted by comparing the post-call rng state against a control draw).

DORMANT/ABSENT: reapplyLayer(regenerated, undefined) and reapplyLayer(regenerated, EMPTY_DM_LAYER) both return the regenerated record REFERENTIALLY unchanged (===) with reapplied [] and dropped [] — the no-draw behaviour.

COUNTERFORCE — the three refusals: an undeclared field, a target id absent from the record, and an op validateOp refuses each return ok:false with the exact closed reason, hand back record and layer === the inputs, and never throw.

BOUNDARY/SPARSE: a layer holding a field for an entity the reroll REMOVED, mixed with two survivors — the survivors are in `reapplied`, the casualty is in `dropped`, the entity is NOT re-created, and both lists are ASCII-ascending and deduplicated.

IDEMPOTENCY: applyEdit twice on one field with different values leaves the RECORD holding the second value while layer.entities[id][field] still holds the ENGINE'S ORIGINAL (never the first DM value); a second reapplyLayer is byte-identical to the first.

LIFECYCLE ROUND TRIP: a real generated settlement → applyEdit → JSON round trip → reapplyLayer onto a fresh generation from the same seed is byte-exact, and mintDmId reproduces the same id for the same (seed, kind, n) across the hop.

⛔ THE ISOLATION PROPERTY IN ITS TRUE, AMENDED FORM (ARCH §8 instrument 7 at 2280742ab): (a) generateSettlementPipeline with an EMPTY layer equals tests/fixtures/generator-golden-master.json BYTE-FOR-BYTE across the 525-row corpus and leaves the prose manifest unmoved; (b) the same seed+config with a ONE-ROOT layer differs from (a) ONLY in that root and the derivations downstream of it, with EVERY UNTOUCHED ROOT IDENTICAL — the executable statement that the overridden chooser still consumed its draw. ANTI-VACUITY: (b) must differ from (a) somewhere, or the layer was never consulted.

DETERMINISM AND THE NAMESPACE: mintDmId throws TypeError on a non-string seed, an unknown kind and a negative / fractional / non-safe n; every valid triple returns dm:<kind>:<16 lowercase hex>; the same triple twice is equal and three distinct triples are distinct.
